name: functional-report-zero-coverage
description: R8 zero-source-success: synthetic isolated-report checkpoint only, not end-to-end skill or live transport coverage. Stage outside a SKILL.md ancestor; replay the reporting phase using the selected actor revision.
prompt: Use `/kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: A successful-looking PAL approval with no source coverage can erase a substantiated independent finding or become unsupported release assurance.

assertions.text: The actor loads the selected isolated review reporting instructions before annotation/reporting; the trace identifies this as a synthetic checkpoint replay, not an actual full skill investigation or live PAL integration.

The report retains the independent reviewer's P1 finding with its trigger, source location and consequence: a provider rejects application while returning ok:true, so candidate save falsely reports success and leaves values unchanged. It attributes the finding to the independent result and does not claim new test execution.

The report explicitly discloses PAL's zero embedded/read source coverage despite its successful no-findings/APPROVE response, preserving that native response with the coverage qualification. It does not present the empty result as corroboration or evidence that the finding is false.

The final assessment retains REQUEST_CHANGES for the demonstrated acceptance violation and withholds unsupported release-safe conclusions; neither the external outcome nor missing deployment evidence cancels the substantiated issue.

The report distinguishes supplied synthetic reviewer evidence from real executions and describes the remaining coverage limit and concrete next action without claiming this replay validates live MCP transport.
